title: My Quiet Bible · Lhaih, guee, rheynn, reesht
description: Lhaih, guee, rheynn, reesht. Yn Vible ayns {versions} çhyndaays as {languages} chengey, cramman 🙏 dy ghuee magh ard mychione ny t’ou lhaih, as kiarkylyn beggey preevaadjagh dy rheynn dty phadjeryn. Nastee, gyn soilshaghey-creck, gobbraghey ass-linney.
sub: Yn Vible ynrican: gyn plannyn, gyn sruthanyn naight, gyn soilshaghey-creck. Nastee, as t’ee gobbraghey ass-linney.
homeScreen: Cur ee er dty Home Screen
computerInstall: Cur ee stiagh er dty cho-earrooder
installAndroid: Cur ee er dty chellvane Android
hint: Gyn screeu dty ennym. T’ee fosley kiart ayns shoh ayns dty frowser.
verseSub: {versions} çhyndaays ayns {languages} chengey, dagh fer jeu ayns y vagher theayagh ny fo kied foshlit. Yn rann cheddin, ayns kuse jeu:
biblesP: {versions} çhyndaays ayns {languages} chengey: yn King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, yn Vible Ebraish as y Conaant Noa Greagish, y canon Etiopagh ayns Baarle, Frangish as Ge’ez, as tooilley. Cosoylee derrey shey cheu-ry-cheu.
searchP: Fockle, raa, daa ockle faggys da’n chielley, ayns un Vible ny ymmodee, lesh ny eiyrtyssyn coontit er lioar. Scrieu coontey er rann as t’ou ayns shen. Earrooyn Strong, neesht.
offlineP: Ta ny Biblyn t’ou lhaih fuirraght er dty chellvane. Er etlan, ayns ny sleityn, ayns shamyr fo-halloo: t’ee fosley er y rann raad haag oo jeh, gyn kiangley erbee.
marksP: Hoght daahyn, noat er rann ny er raad slane, rebban son ny ynnydyn t’ou cheet back huc. Cur lhiat ny ren oo freayll ayns app Bible elley. Cowree rann myr lesh pen soilshey, ny daaghee ny lettyryn echey.
devicesP: Ynrican my sailt. Gow stiagh lesh passkey ny coad currit er post-L, as ta dty hoilshaghyn, noatyn as reaghyssyn geiyrt ort. Ta nah ghreie goll stiagh veih’n chied fer lesh un kiangley; veg dy scrieu.
verseShareP: Cur rann gys WhatsApp, Facebook ny X lesh un vennalt, myr jalloo kiune jeant er dty chree hene.
readingP: Shey clowanyn, fer jeu jeant son sleih nagh vel fakin dy mie. Screeu cha mooar as t’ou laccal, as crammanyn nagh vod oo gailleil. Skyrr dy chaghlaa yn caibil. Soilshagh, Sepia ny Dorraghey, myr y duillag shoh.
nots:
• Gyn plannyn lhaih. Gyn smooinaghtyn laa er laa. Veg reiht er dty hon.
  • Gyn soilshaghey-creck. Gyn eiyrtys. Gyn cookies.
  • Gyn eeck. Cha nel veg glast.
  • Cha nel feme er coontey. Gow stiagh ynrican my t’ou laccal sync.
free: Ta My Quiet Bible nastee, as bee ee nastee dy bragh. My t’ee cooney lhiat, foddee oo cooney lesh freayll y lampey soilshean. Cha bee veg rieau croghey er shen.
installSub: Eisht t’ee fosley er y scaileen slane myr app erbee elley, t’ee freayll dty ynnyd, as t’ee gobbraghey gyn kiangley.
installSubComputer: Eisht t’ee fosley ayns e uinnag hene myr app erbee elley, t’ee freayll dty ynnyd, as t’ee gobbraghey gyn kiangley.
iosSteps:
• Foshil y Vible ayns Safari.
  • Bean rish cramman y menu ayns barr yn enmys, eisht Share {svg}. Er iPhones shenn, ta Share kiart ayns y barr heese.
  • Bean rish View More, eisht Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Faag Open as Web App er as bean rish Add. Hig y lampey er dty Home Screen.
iosNote: Jean eh veih’n Vible, cha nee veih’n duillag shoh, dy vod y lampey fosley kiart ayns dty lhaih. Jean ymmyd jeh Safari: cha nod frowseryn elley er iPhone as iPad app y chur stiagh dy kinjagh.
orSafari: Ny, gyn App Store, veih Safari:
androidNote: Un vean. Cha nel veg goll trooid shapp app.
androidInstalled: Currit stiagh. Foshil y lampey marish dty apps elley.
androidSteps:
• Foshil y Vible ayns Chrome, ny yn frowser t’ou ymmydey.
  • Foshil menu y frowser, tree pointyn {svg} heose er y laue yesh dy mennick.
  • Bean rish Install and create shortcut (ta frowseryn ennagh gra Add to Home screen).
  • Reih Install, cha nee Create shortcut. Eisht bean rish Install reesht.
  • Hig y lampey marish dty apps elley.
computerNote: T’ee fosley ayns e uinnag hene, myr app erbee elley.
computerInstalled: Currit stiagh. Foshil My Quiet Bible marish dty apps elley.
computerSteps:
• Foshil y Vible ayns Chrome ny Edge.
  • Click er jalloo y chur-stiagh ec kione yesh barr yn enmys, scaileen lesh sythe {svg}, eisht Install.
  • Ny freill y tab foshlit. T’eh gobbraghey myr shen neesht, as t’eh cooinaghtyn dty ynnyd.
footNote: Ta dagh screeu ayns y vagher theayagh ny fo kied foshlit. Ta kied dagh çhyndaays ayns yn app.
prayP: magh ard, lesh un chramman, mychione ny lhaih oo nish.
shareP: dty phadjeryn, tra sailt, lesh beggan sleih faggys dhyt.
repeatP: mairagh. T’ee freayll dty ynnyd, as dty laaghyn fer lurg fer.
prayLong: Ta’n cramman 🙏 kinjagh ayns shen, rish y barr shirree. Bean rish as abbyr dty phadjer magh ard. T’ee freilt marish ny rannaghyn v’ou lhaih, dy vod oo clashtyn ee reesht ny s’anmey as fakin cre son ghuee oo.
prayTicks:
• Veg dy scrieu as veg dy reaghey.
  • Ta dty phadjeryn fuirraght er dty chellvane, ny ta sync orroo glast lesh eochair nagh vel ec agh uss.
  • Lurg Amen, jeeagh er ny cheeraghyn raad ren sleih guee yn çhiaghtin shoh. Cha nel agh y cheer er ny coontey.
circlesVerse: “Son raad ta jees ny troor er nyn jaglym cooidjagh ayns m’ennym, ta mish ayns shen ayns y vean oc.”
circlesLong: Tra sailt, jean kiarkyl beg son dty lught-thie ny beggan caarjyn. Rheynn padjer, rann ny noat lesh un vean. T’ad clashtyn, freggyrt lesh fockle, ny lesh 🙏, as ta dagh fer jeu lhaih y rann ayns e Vible hene.
circlesAsk: Jean aghin rish dty chiarkyl dy ghuee er dty hon, as jeeagh quoid t’er nyn guee.
circlesTicks:
• Cha nel eh eignit rieau. Cha nel veg faagail dty chellvane mannagh vel oo bentyn rish Rheynn.
  • Ta eochair hene ec dagh kiarkyl. Cha nod agh ny oltyn eh y fosley ny t’ayn; cha nod shinyn hene eer.
  • Shegin da kirkylyn çheet stiagh nastee, lesh ard-ochill ny coad currit ec post-l.
listenP: Bwoaill rish rann, as eisht Clasht. Lhaih eh veih shen derrey nee oo eh y stappal, as soilshee dagh fockle myr t’eh lhaiht. Ta lhaihderyn firrinagh lhaih yn BSB, yn King James as yn Louis Segond. Son y ghleashtan, y chishtey, ny sooillyn skee.
